hints.title: Partition Condition Difference
hints.text: A valid pivot split at index p requires prefix sum equal to suffix sum, meaning sum left minus sum right equals zero.

hints.title: Prefix Delta Formulation
hints.text: Let total be the array sum and pref[p] be prefix sum up to p. Valid pivot requires two times pref[p] minus total equals zero.

hints.title: Replacing Single Element at Index i
hints.text: Replacing nums[i] with k shifts total by delta. Pivots to the left of i shift delta from right to left, while pivots at or to the right of i shift delta directly.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def waysToPartition(self, nums: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        total = sum(nums)
        pref = [0] * n
        pref[0] = nums[0]
        for i in range(1, n):
            pref[i] = pref[i - 1] + nums[i]
        diffs = [2 * pref[i] - total for i in range(n - 1)]
        right_count = Counter(diffs)
        left_count = Counter()
        ans = right_count[0]
        for i in range(n):
            d = k - nums[i]
            curr = left_count[d] + right_count[-d]
            ans = max(ans, curr)
            if i < n - 1:
                diff = diffs[i]
                right_count[diff] -= 1
                left_count[diff] += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(N) linear scan maintaining left and right difference frequency maps
complexity.space: O(N) to store prefix differences and hash counters
variables: N: number of elements in nums
complexity.notes: Transferring difference keys between left and right maps runs in O(1) per index.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing partition validity for every element replacement requires quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual frequency maps dynamically maintain relative difference transitions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should express partition balance as prefix difference and slide across pivot changes.
